results.title: Universal reversible-relaxation convexity forces a chi-square divergence profile
results.match_scope: candidate only; not an applicability verdict
results.statement: Claim: Let {D_n}_{n>=1} be finite-valued nonnegative functionals on strictly positive finite probability simplices, normalized by D_n(q,q)=0. Assume data processing under rectangular stochastic maps whose input and output distributions have full support, and for each fixed q assume continuity in p on the open simplex and C^2 regularity away from p=q. The source states that universal convexity of t↦D_n(p exp(tL),q) for every finite alphabet, full-support p,q and irreducible q-reversible continuous-time Markov generator L is equivalent to one alphabet-independent Ψ in C([0,infinity))∩C^2((0,infinity)) with D_n(p,q)=Ψ(χ²(p||q)), Ψ(0)=0, Ψ'(s)>=0 and Ψ'(s)+sΨ''(s)>=0. No tensor-additivity or trace-form premise is needed. As separate corollaries, tensor additivity forces D_n=c log(1+χ²), c>=0 (the order-two Rényi divergence); within that additive class, requiring D'''(t)<=0 along every finite reversible relaxation forces D=0. Under the same data-processing and regularity assumptions, convexity along every irreducible finite stationary generator, including nonreversible ones, forces D=0 without tensor additivity.

card_roles.text:
EXACT CLAIM
For the self-adjoint two-sector Hamiltonian H(g), an isolated finite native code at E, a domain-valid normalizable divided source (H_B-E)U1=-VP, and a domain-valid second dressing U2 give an exact residual of orders g^3 and g^4. Duhamel yields an O(|g|) code-isometry approximation to exp(-i tau K) at time hbar*tau/g^2, including reference-entangled inputs and finite-sequence telescoping. An exactly circular full-hyperfine rotation and magnetic parity supply a conditional finite-spin extension while retaining the deliberately open channel; its three-level nonaffine phase remains nonzero. The1143increment proves a separate spectral-window residual certificate even if the exact second divided vector is nonnormalizable: with no resonant point projection and the stated domain/graph bounds, shrinking windows yield o(1)code error on g^-2 times (regular density permits a conservative O(sqrt|g|)bound). Full physical quadratic curvature W must enter K: an axis-tilt source cancels its proposed many-body XX/ZZ interaction, while a positive three-body commutator loop is dominated by exact native conjugation using the same controls.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Self-adjoint closed Hamiltonian, actual divided-source range/domain conditions, native code gap in its own sector, coherent code preparation, and controlled source parameters. The spin extension assumes the common native motional potential and exactly circular spatial coupling; full physical fields require additional bounds. The window theorem needs an exact first dressing, no omitted resonant discrete code state, and actual finite V/W actions of the cutoff columns. Periodic evaluations need Fourier l1 control at physical time. Changed native CP/PEC models use their actual eigenstates/energies/source response, not inherited Morse witnesses.

BOUNDARIES
Earlier exact two-sector/circular-spin results remain valid at their own domains. The new full finite-width magnetic residual is numerically evaluated, not an interval-certified integrated electric/surface/noise device. First-source defect still costs tau*||R1||/|g|; a resonant point projection requires an enlarged effective code or a physical selection rule. Different magnetic, electric and native-trap constructions must not be combined into one apparatus. The original integer phase witness is invalid after native gaps change. Equal linear absorption data do not identify quadratic source curvature or an order-one phase-time operation.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Phase time scales as g^-2; fixed profile mismatch has sufficient allowance A|g|+B*eta/|g| and fixed Hamiltonian errors can cost delta/g^2. Source-reported exact-rational two-channel examples at g=.001/.0001 give isometry bounds .069444719166/.006944468042 with very long plateaux. Full-spin constants require recomputation. Balanced Raman exposure can diverge as 1/g; stronger unbalanced Raman and opposite-detuning controls remain allowed comparators. No generic phase-gate superiority is shown. The reported full magnetic finite-width bounds still have enormous plateaux. Finite trap/PEC/CP repairs have distinct assumptions and numerical constants. At phase pi/8 the100-cycle three-body loop reports12.53314/J and error.062540; same-control exact conjugation takespi/(2J)and has zero algebraic error. Native noise, pulse drift, survival/input filtering and source action remain inclusive; smaller g alone does not improve the limiting loss/phase/source-action ratios.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Find an actual physical control family whose completed quadratic response retains a consequential operation beyond its equally equipped controller, with full residual/preparation/readout/noise/source costs. No thermodynamic-limit heating result, new generic many-body primitive, integrated apparatus or practical superiority is established.

results.title: A piecewise quadratic scalar flattening has sharp quartic remainder constant eight

statement.assertion: ||psi(uprime)-psi(u)||_l1(w)^2<=8[||uprime-e||H^4-||u-e||H^4-4||u-e||H^2<u-e,uprime-u>]; 8 is optimal among coordinatewise C1 endpoint-fixing scalar functions.
assumptions: Cube coordinate signs relative to a fixed corner; nonnegative weights.
Sharpness uses arbitrary finite weights/dimensions and scalar C1 endpoint fixing.
Stationary chain extension needs its own exact cut lift and bounded stopping martingale.
statement.quantifiers: Every finite weighted Hilbert H=l2(w), cube Q=[0,1]^N, corner e and points u,uprime; psi(s)=2s^2 for s<=1/2 and 1-2(1-s)^2 otherwise.

conditions: Cube coordinate signs relative to a fixed corner; nonnegative weights.
Sharpness uses arbitrary finite weights/dimensions and scalar C1 endpoint fixing.
Stationary chain extension needs its own exact cut lift and bounded stopping martingale.
operation_frame.construction: Use |psiprime(s)|<=4|s-e| and coordinate signs to bound each difference by 2|delta||a+b|. Cauchy-Schwarz and 2R-d||a+b||^2=8(r+d/4)^2+d^2/2 establish 8. Balanced two-dimensional perturbations imply |etaprime(s)|<=sqrt(2C)min(s,1-s); integrating forces C>=8. Quartic martingale telescoping eliminates derivative terms. Stationarity evaluates accumulated stop and move weights as 1 and t; geometric horizon comparison needs no time reversal.
costs: General finite cut representation can involve 2^n-2 subsets; rational finite coordinates permit the separate sorted-level polynomial compiler.
Sharp8 does not establish sharp224 or any infinite-coordinate finite algorithm.
obstruction: No reversibility or independent increments required; replacing stationarity by an arbitrary initial law needs a new argument.
One-bank Poincare consequence is not a two-bank absolute spectral inequality.
